decisions: JAYA_MASTER_AUTONOMOUS_DEV_GUIDE_v3.md is the highest-authority specification; the v1.0 guide is subordinate compatible detail.
Begin as a bounded modular monolith, preserving module-owned data and public API/event contracts.
No implementation capability may be marked complete without repository evidence and applicable test results.
DOC-001 planning baseline is accepted; FND-001 is the first implementation task.
FND-001 will be delivered as separately reviewable subtasks, beginning with the local executable toolchain before CI and boundary enforcement.
The exact .nvmrc value is the pinned development runtime, while engines.node may remain a compatible supported-runtime range; packageManager must identify an exact npm version.
FND-001a is accepted as delivered, not as completion of FND-001 or Phase 0.

FND-001b is accepted as delivered: all source roots, the architecture manifest, four static boundary checks, and planted violation proofs are present; P0-10 remains partial because four specified checks are deferred to schema/contracts/policy artefacts.

FND-001c must use immutable action SHAs, least-privilege permissions, exact toolchain pins, full verification, and a high/critical dependency-audit gate with an automated anti-weakening contract test.
concerns: There is no database, authentication, deployment, or monitoring foundation yet.
The eventual production/staging environments and external provider credentials may require later human or cloud-access escalation, but do not block local foundation work.
The baseline requirement count is extensive and must remain mechanically verifiable as statuses change.
Boundary enforcement cannot detect runtime indirection, cross-module raw SQL, or unlisted provider SDKs, and treats the kernel as one layer; later checks and reviews must cover these limits.
GitHub currently reports no checks, so CI-dependent gates cannot be accepted.
The CI workflow must honor both exact development pins and supply-chain safety; mutable action tags are insufficient.

Repeated FND-001c instructions have produced no visible repository changes, suggesting a local execution, git, push, ignore, or permissions blocker that must be identified before another delivery attempt.
last_instruction: Investigate why the previous FND-001c instruction produced no repository changes or GitHub workflow run, without modifying files: inspect the local branch/worktree, git remotes and push capability, ignored/untracked files under `.github`, and any command or permission failures, then report the precise root cause with the relevant command outputs and the smallest corrective action needed.
